Subject: LaunchPath onboarding stipend — asking about split options

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Our LaunchPath cohort is moving quickly and the partners committee asked whether Redwood can be flexible on how the onboarding stipend is delivered. The sponsor will cover $30,000 total but they're open to a mix between free platform credits and near-term usage discounts (or an invoice credit).

Two constraints from our side:
- We need line-item clarity on invoices for our finance team (they want a PO + separate invoice lines for credits vs services).
- We require any multi-month discounts to be reflected in an addendum rather than altering the base SaaS terms.

Can Redwood do: (A) $20k in platform credits + (B) a 3-month 30% usage discount capped at $10k? If that isn't straightforward, what alternatives do you recommend (e.g., lump-sum invoice credit or extended trial window with consumption cap)?

Attached is the LaunchPath Program SOW for context (LaunchPath-Program-SOW.pdf). Our target start date is 2027-03-20; ideally paperwork and PO are done by 2027-03-11.

Best,
Eva Lopez
Program Director, LaunchPath
---
Eva Lopez
LaunchPath
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LaunchPath onboarding stipend — asking about split options

Lauren / Vivek — forwarding LaunchPath ask. Quick read: $30k sponsor, they prefer $20k credits + $10k as a 30% usage discount over 3 months, plus PO/invoice separation. PO deadline 3/11, program starts 3/20.

Options I see (pros/cons):
1) Credits + discount (their preference) — Pros: easy for adoption; Cons: billing complexity, finance needs line items, discounts require addendum to terms.
2) Lump-sum invoice credit applied up front — Pros: clean invoice; Cons: less visible to customer in console, could be treated differently for accounting.
3) Extended trial + consumption cap — Pros: minimal legal change; Cons: may not satisfy sponsor and partner committee.

Questions:
- Legal/finance: can we issue an invoice where 20k shows as "platform credits" (non-refundable service credit) and the remaining 10k is represented as a separate discount line tied to usage, and have both reflected on a single invoice and separate GL codes?
- Revenue recognition: any concerns with splitting stipend between credits and discounts?

If we can do credits + discount cleanly, I'm comfortable proposing that. If not, suggest we offer a $30k gross invoice credit and call it a "sponsorship stipend" with a short addendum.

I'll draft a customer-facing note once we agree the ops/legal approach.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchPath onboarding stipend — ops suggestion

Ben, Vivek — quick reply after a sync with finance. We can support the credits + discount split, with the following guardrails:

- Structure: 20,000 USD in platform credits (applied to account as non-refundable credits), plus a 3-month program-tier discount of 30% capped at 10,000 USD on invoiced usage. Both items should appear as separate lines on the invoice.
- Revenue / accounting: finance will bill credits as deferred revenue to be recognized over the first 3 months of consumption; the discount line will be recorded as contra-revenue. No issue in principle but needs GL mapping (we'll provide codes).
- Contract: require a one-page addendum referencing deal DF-4719 with two bullets clarifying credit amount and discount term; no change to base T&Cs.
- Ops: ask CS to enable "program credit" code so credits are visible in the customer console.

I attached a suggested split workbook (proposed-stipend-split.xlsx) and a short addendum template.

If Ben can get PO and sponsor sign-off, I can ask legal to review the addendum and finance to prepare invoice templates.

— Lauren
Director, Revenue Operations
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Eva Lopez <eva.lopez@launchpath.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: LaunchPath onboarding stipend — asking about split options

Hi Eva — appreciate the clarity and quick turnaround. We can do the split you suggested. Summary of proposal: 

- Sponsorship total: $30,000 (sponsor-funded).
- Delivery: $20,000 in platform credits that will appear as a "LaunchPath program credit" line in the console; $10,000 as a 30% usage discount applied to invoiced consumption for the first 3 months, capped at $10,000.
- Contracting: one-page addendum referencing deal DF-4719 to reflect the discount term; base Redwood T&Cs unchanged.
- Invoicing: Redwood will issue a PO-based invoice with separate line items for the credits and the discount. Finance will provide GL codes and a final invoice template prior to issuance.

Next steps for LaunchPath:
1) Please send the PO to finance@redwood.com with the exact legal entity name and billing address (we received a tentative PO but need the finalized one).
2) Confirm sponsor sign-off on the 20k/10k split (reply to this thread).
3) Once PO is in, we will route the addendum to your legal and finalize the invoice.

I've attached the PO they sent and a draft invoice stub (LP-PO-20270309.pdf). Targeting paperwork complete by 2027-03-11 so we can activate credits before 3/20.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
